releaseNotes.zh-CN:
MyCodex 8.0.2 更新日志

本次汇总 7.0 之后的重要变化，包含全新的认证中心、多供应商模型聚合、多环境同时使用、电脑操作和运行时更新。

从 7.0 及更早版本升级请注意：认证中心已重新实现，原来的认证配置可能需要手动重新添加，模型和权限也需要重新设置。

• 全新的认证中心
ChatGPT 账号、官方 API 和第三方服务统一在“供应商”列表中管理，可搜索预设、编辑、复制和切换。ChatGPT 支持浏览器登录、设备码登录和已保存账号。新配置保存后，选择“启用”才会切换。旧版“模型中转”和 OpenRouter 独立窗口已取消；这里修改的是当前环境的 Codex 配置，也会影响使用同一配置目录的命令行和其他客户端。

• 多供应商模型聚合
在认证中心选择“聚合模型”，可以把多家供应商的模型一起放进 Codex 的模型列表，每个模型都标注供应商名称。选中哪个模型，请求就发给对应的供应商，其他请求仍发给默认供应商；同一个会话中也可以换用其他供应商的模型。ChatGPT 账号可以作为默认供应商，此时需要打开“统一 Codex 会话历史”。聚合不做故障转移。停止聚合后名单会保留，下次开启时恢复。退出 MyCodex 时，Codex 命令行和其他客户端会改回默认供应商直连；下次启动自动恢复聚合，并保留所选的模型和推理强度。

• 统一 Codex 会话历史
默认关闭。开启后，切换账号或第三方服务也能接着聊旧会话。迁移的会话会暂时不在官方客户端中显示；关闭后会还原此前迁移的会话，开启期间新建的会话仍只能通过第三方服务继续。修复不兼容历史时会保留备份，舍弃旧压缩摘要前会先征求确认。

• 多个环境同时工作
本机 Windows、不同的 WSL 和 SSH 目标可以各开自己的窗口，分别保存设置、会话和自动化任务。关闭一个，不影响其他窗口；目标也可以改名。

• Windows 电脑操作和内置 Git
可以让 Codex 帮你操作本机应用和浏览器，所需组件随软件提供，无需另装官方 Codex 桌面端。软件也附带 Git，基本的本机 Git 操作无需额外安装。

• 内置运行时更新更方便
本机使用内置 Codex 时，启动或切回内置运行时会静默检查更新。发现新版后由你确认下载，也可暂不更新；下载和安装会显示进度，成功后提示完成并清理不用的旧版本。检查失败时仍可继续使用当前版本。

• 补充回答、模型和代码审查
Codex 提问时可选建议答案或自行输入，也可稍后回答，切换问题会保留草稿。模型可获取或手动添加，并补齐能识别的上下文长度和推理等级。子代理列表增加状态、最近工作和上下级关系；代码审查支持分支差异、指定提交和自定义要求。

• 界面和读屏体验
新增 100%、125%、150% 字号选择，重启后生效；会话标题可以优先显示和朗读。改善大量日志、代码等长消息刷新时的卡顿，完整内容仍可查看和供读屏读取。

• 常用入口调整
另开一条对话继续时，请使用“分叉”，也支持从已结束的轮次分叉；代码差异可在 Git 工作台查看。独立技能市场已取消，插件附带的技能随插件安装，已有技能仍可管理。

• 重要修复
修复部分旧配置导致 DeepSeek、自定义 API 等服务无法添加或启用，以及切换服务后旧会话仍提示缺少环境变量的问题；修复在线更新下载后无法继续安装，以及客户端退出后仍无法卸载的问题。
releaseNotes.en-US:
MyCodex 8.0.2 Release Notes

This summary covers the main changes since 7.0: a rebuilt Authentication Center, model aggregation across providers, multiple environments at once, computer use, and runtime updates.

Upgrading from 7.0 or earlier: The Authentication Center has been rebuilt. You may need to add your authentication configurations again and will need to set your model and permissions again.

• Rebuilt Authentication Center
Manage ChatGPT accounts, the official API, and third-party services in one provider list, with searchable presets, editing, copying, and switching. ChatGPT supports browser sign-in, device codes, and saved accounts. Save a new configuration, then choose Enable to switch to it. The separate model conversion and OpenRouter windows have been removed. Changes apply to the current environment's Codex configuration and also affect the CLI and other clients sharing that configuration directory.

• Model aggregation across providers
In the Authentication Center, choose Aggregate models to bring models from several providers into the Codex model list, each marked with its provider name. A request for one of these models goes to its provider; other requests go to the default provider, and a conversation can switch to another provider's model. A ChatGPT account can be the default provider when Unified Codex session history is on. Aggregation does not fail over. Stopping aggregation keeps the list of providers for next time. When MyCodex exits, the Codex CLI and other clients point back to the default provider directly; the next start restores aggregation along with the selected model and reasoning level.

• Unified Codex session history
Off by default. Enable it to continue earlier conversations after switching accounts or third-party services. Migrated sessions are temporarily hidden in the official client. Turning it off restores previously migrated sessions; sessions created while it was on can then only be continued through third-party services. Repairs keep a backup and ask before discarding older conversation summaries.

• Multiple environments at once
Local Windows, individual WSL distributions, and SSH targets can each have their own window, settings, conversations, and automations. Closing one leaves the others running. Targets can also be renamed.

• Windows computer use and bundled Git
Let Codex help operate local applications and browsers. The required components are included, so the official Codex desktop app is not required. Git is also bundled for basic local Git tasks.

• Easier built-in runtime updates
When using built-in Codex on This PC, MyCodex silently checks at startup and after switching back to the built-in runtime. You choose whether to download an available update or postpone it. Download and installation progress is shown, followed by a completion message and cleanup of unused older versions. If the check fails, you can keep using the current version.

• Follow-up answers, models, and code review
Choose a suggested answer, enter your own, or answer later when Codex asks for more information. Drafts are kept when switching questions. Retrieve or manually add models, with missing context lengths and reasoning levels filled in when recognized. Subagents now show status, recent work, and parent relationships. Code review supports branch differences, specific commits, and custom instructions.

• Display and screen reader experience
Choose 100%, 125%, or 150% font size after restarting, and place session titles first for display and reading. Long messages containing large logs or code refresh more smoothly, while full content remains available for viewing and screen readers.

• Changes to common actions
Use Fork to continue in a separate conversation, including from a finished turn. View code differences in the Git Workbench. The standalone skill marketplace has been removed; plugin skills are installed with their plugins, and existing skills remain manageable.

• Important fixes
Fixed old configurations preventing DeepSeek, custom APIs, and other services from being added or enabled, and existing conversations reporting missing environment variables after switching providers. Also fixed installation failing after an update download and uninstallation being blocked after the client had exited.
